item.title: For Years, The 'Immunity Dog' Has Been Protecting Us From Evil Social Media Posts
item.description: Immunity Dog is an image macro meme format where an image of a dog is shared with a caption claiming that the meme will protect you from other image macros and posts which claim that something bad will happen to you if you don't interact with the post in some way. The original Immunity Dog meme started circulating online as early as October 2016 and continued spreading over the following years, inspiring new variations and memes referencing the original.

item.title: 'Paloma Blanca' Becomes Latest Viral Dance And Animation Trend
item.description: Paloma Blanca is a song originally released by George Baker in 1975, which became a viral dance trend in August 2025. The trend uses the song along with a choreographed line dance from the Japanese dance team Avantgardey, which led to several videos and fan animations, including animation memes, using the dance and song on platforms like TikTok and YouTube.

item.title: Pink Guy's 2015 Song 'Meme Machine' Making A Big Comeback As The 'Great Meme Reset' Prepares For Launch
item.description: Inhale the Memes, Exhale the Memes, is a selection of lyrics from the song "Meme Machine" by Pink Guy, aka Filthy Frank. The song was released as part of the June 25th, 2015 TVFilthyFrank YouTube video "TOILET SRIRACHA SHRIMP" and became the subject of memes over the following years, including lip dubs on TikTok throughout 2025. Notably, a now-deleted TikTok video of @badguyincorporated lip dubbing to the song while wearing a Homestuck shirt became the subject of recreations and memes.

item.title: Eight Years Ago Today, The 'Anthony Adams Rubbing Hands Together' Meme Appeared Online
item.description: Anthony Adams Rubbing Hands Together refers to a photograph of former professional football player Anthony "Spice" Adams dressed in a yellow jacket, peeking from behind a tree, rubbing his hands and licking his lips. Online, the photograph has gained popularity as a reaction image.

item.title: Today's The Day That 'Boxxy' First Posted On I-Am-Bored, So Maybe Today's The Day You Post Face
item.description: Boxxy is an internet personality who posted a series of hyperactive and seemingly innocuous monologues in January 2009.
